pages.text: A box-cab electric: 60 km/h, the strongest engine there is.

It runs on $(thing)BuildCraft power$() (MJ) from its batteries: a million MJ, about twenty minutes at full power. Standing still it uses next to nothing. When they're flat it stops, and the gauges say FLAT.$(br2)Charge it at a $(l:depots/charging_point)charging point$(/l), or run it under $(l:electric/overhead_lines)overhead wires$(/l), which charge it as it goes.
Drive it from the front cab. Its motors hum, the whine climbing as it gathers speed; working hard, the odd spark flies from under it. It has a two-tone horn, and won't take coal or diesel.
